description: Two physics grad students in Indonesia (KNB scholars): astronomy at ITB and materials physics at ITS. Skills: ML, atmospheric modelling, data analysis (Python, PyTorch, Streamlit). We're building a web tool that detects and maps statistically significant trends in NASA Earth data: Mann-Kendall/Sen's slope with autocorrelation and FDR corrections, change-point detection, and plain-language summaries. Looking for data viz, web dev, or Earth science teammates. Fully online (UTC+7).
